benefits.name: One Key Silver Tier Status
benefits.description: Automatic Silver tier status in the One Key loyalty program (Expedia, Hotels.com, Vrbo), including member savings of 15% or more on over 10,000 hotels worldwide.
benefits.terms: Gold tier requires $15,000 in annual card spend.

benefits.name: Cellular Telephone Protection
benefits.description: Up to $1,000 per claim against damage, theft or loss when the monthly cell phone bill is paid with the card.
benefits.terms: $25 deductible per claim; maximum of 2 paid claims and $2,000 per 12-month period. Excludes cracked screens/cosmetic damage, tablets and smartwatches.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Coverage up to $50,000 for damage/theft of a rental vehicle paid with the card; primary coverage (secondary for New York residents).
benefits.terms: Rental periods up to 31 consecutive days, U.S. and international. Pay the full rental with the card and decline the rental company's collision damage waiver.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Protection
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $5,000 per covered traveler per trip for prepaid, non-refundable travel expenses, up to $20,000 per account per 12-month period.

benefits.name: Travel Accident Insurance
benefits.description: Up to $1,000,000 per account of common carrier travel accident coverage when the entire fare is paid with the card.

earningRates.terms: Earned as OneKeyCash, which can only be redeemed on Expedia, Hotels.com and Vrbo (not for cash).
